title: Financial scenario planning
description: Planning comparisons that make cost, timing and demand assumptions visible to decision owners.

rules.instruction: Compare a base case with relevant downside or upside scenarios using the same period, units and definitions. Document assumptions about timing, capacity and input costs.
rules.verification: Recompute one outcome from source inputs and compare totals with the planning basis. Review the scenario ranges with the finance owner.

rules.instruction: Vary the assumptions that drive the choice and record values at which the preferred option would change. Note dependencies between inputs before combining changes.
rules.verification: Have the finance owner reproduce a sensitivity result and confirm which estimate should be improved before making the decision.
